items.title: Quest Diagnostics (DGX) Reaffirms Dividend, Is The Stock Already Fully Valued?
items.summary: Quest Diagnostics (DGX) just reaffirmed its capital return approach. The Board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.86 per share, payable January 27, 2027, to shareholders of record on January 12. That dividend decision comes after a strong run in Quest Diagnostics' stock, with a 30-day share price return of 12.67% and a year-to-date share price gain of 49.40% pointing to firm momentum, while the 3-year total shareholder return of 103.66% reflects a longer record of value creation. items.title: Quest Diagnostics (DGX) Stock Could Be 31% Undervalued Following RESULTS Act Push
